one_liner: Adley Rutschman saw only 1,403 pitches in 2025 -- a short season by this pull's standards -- and returned a .315 estimated wOBA on contact.
three_things: 1,403 pitches seen is roughly half the exposure of the group's iron men.
463 batted balls at 84.3 mph average exit velocity.
He is a switch hitter, so the sample mixes both sides of the plate.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (pitches_faced_2025>=300 floor, 485 of 671 batters). The contact numbers -- exit velocity and estimated wOBA on contact -- cover the batted balls only, not every pitch seen, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model: it says nothing about walks, strikeouts, or actual results. This pull carries no swing/miss or launch-angle column, so there is no whiff rate and no barrel profile here. Not park-, role-, or opponent-adjusted, and not a prediction. A shortened season widens the error bars on every contact number here; nothing in this pull explains why the exposure was short.
